user_reported_bug: in map it is showing default map i want the live locvation for it
summary: No relevant testing skill found. Focused Playwright testing with granted mock geolocation (28.6139, 77.2090) showed the no-drone map centers on the live location, renders the pulsing user marker and accuracy circle, enables/recenters via btn-map-my-location, and pre-fills Add Drone home coordinates. Permission-denied fallback also worked. However the required Add Drone 'Use My Location' control is not rendered at data-testid btn-use-my-location, so the live-location change set is incomplete.

ui_bugs.issue: The required 'Use My Location' button is missing from the Add Drone dialog. Runtime evidence: locator [data-testid='btn-use-my-location'] count was 0 while Home Lat/Home Lon were correctly prefilled with 28.6139/77.209.

action_items: Render the AddDroneDialog 'Use My Location' button with data-testid='btn-use-my-location' and wire it to the existing useMyLocation handler/toast.
Set homeTouched=true when users manually edit Home Lat/Home Lon so later geolocation updates do not overwrite manual values.
Review DroneMap's guard that skips initial flyTo when drones.length > 0; the requested behavior says the map should fly to the user's GPS coordinates once permission is granted.
critical_code_review_comments: AddDroneDialog.js defines useMyLocation() but never renders a button that calls it, causing the required selector and user-visible action to be absent.
Home Lat/Home Lon onChange handlers update coordinate state but never set homeTouched=true, so the 'until user edits' behavior is not implemented correctly.
DroneMap.js returns early from the first user-location flyTo when drones.length > 0, which can leave users away from their live GPS in sessions that already have drones.
seed_data_creation: No seed data or drones were created. API /api/drones returned an empty list before testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use Playwright context.grant_permissions(['geolocation']) and context.set_geolocation({latitude: 28.6139, longitude: 77.2090, accuracy: 25}) before/reload navigation. Confirm the map marker is centered, btn-map-my-location works, Add Drone home fields are Delhi coordinates, and btn-use-my-location exists and triggers the reset/toast.
rca_of_the_issue: The core map geolocation path works in the empty-fleet case, but the Add Drone dialog only defines the useMyLocation handler; it does not render the required button. Reproduction: grant mock geolocation, open Add Drone, query [data-testid='btn-use-my-location']; count is 0.
